blocks.text: Woh compounds jin ka chemical formula aur bonds ek jaise hon lekin ligands ki space (fiza) mein tarteeb mukhtalif ho, stereoisomers kehlate hain. Stereoisomerism ki do qismein hain: geometrical isomerism aur optical isomerism.

blocks.prompt: Complexes mein stereoisomerism ki do qismein batayein.

items: Stereoisomers: formula aur bonds wahi, ligands ki space mein tarteeb alag; do qismein: geometrical aur optical.
